skills.label: Access Review Runner
skills.desc: Lists who holds which permission, asks each owner to confirm or revoke it, and records the outcome and date.

skills.label: Approval Gate Designer
skills.desc: Decides which actions need a human approval, who approves, what they see and how long a request may wait.

skills.label: Separation of Duties Checker
skills.desc: Checks that no one person or agent can both request and approve a risky action, and lists the conflicts found.

skills.label: Least Privilege Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews what each user and agent can reach, flags permissions never used and proposes narrower roles.

skills.label: Change Approval Planner
skills.desc: Defines which changes need review, tests and a rollback plan before release and tracks approvals against them.

skills.label: Corrective Action Tracker
skills.desc: Tracks each follow-up action from an incident or audit to closure, with its owner, due date and evidence that it was fixed.

skills.label: Decision Record Keeper
skills.desc: Records each significant decision with options, reasons, who decided and when it should be revisited.

skills.label: Incident Review Writer
skills.desc: Writes a blameless review with timeline, causes, what worked and actions with owners and dates.

skills.label: Audit Sampler
skills.desc: Chooses a defensible sample of events or records for review and states the sampling method and the confidence it supports.

skills.label: Audit Trail Designer
skills.desc: Defines which events are logged, with what fields, for how long and who may read them, so the trail answers who, what, when and why.

skills.label: Lineage Tracer
skills.desc: Traces an output back through the data, prompts, tools and decisions that produced it and marks any link that is missing.

skills.label: Log Integrity Checker
skills.desc: Checks logs for gaps, reordering and edits using hashes or signatures and reports what could not be verified.

skills.label: Control Framework Mapper
skills.desc: Maps one set of controls to several frameworks so one piece of evidence can serve more than one audit.

skills.label: Control Test Scheduler
skills.desc: Schedules recurring tests of each control, records pass or fail with the date and opens a ticket when a control drifts out of compliance.

skills.label: Compliance Evidence Collector
skills.desc: Lists the evidence each control needs, who holds it, how fresh it is and which items are missing.

skills.label: Compliance Gap Assessor
skills.desc: Compares current practice with a framework requirement by requirement and ranks gaps by risk and effort.

skills.label: Policy Exception Tracker
skills.desc: Records each approved exception with its owner, reason and expiry date and flags exceptions that have lapsed.

skills.label: Policy Conflict Checker
skills.desc: Finds rules that contradict each other or overlap and proposes which one should prevail and why.

skills.label: Policy Drafter
skills.desc: Drafts a policy with scope, rules, named exceptions and an owner, written so a program could check each rule.

skills.label: Policy Version Tracker
skills.desc: Tracks each change to a policy with date, author and reason, and shows which agents ran under which version.

skills.label: Personal Data Inventory Builder
skills.desc: Lists what personal data is held, where, why and for how long, and who it is shared with.

skills.label: Data Subject Request Handler
skills.desc: Walks a person's access or deletion request through verification, search, redaction and reply within the deadline.

skills.label: Retention and Minimisation Planner
skills.desc: Sets how long each kind of data is kept, what is deleted or anonymised afterwards and how deletion is proven.

skills.label: Retention and Deletion Scheduler
skills.desc: Sets how long each class of data is kept, who approves deletion and how deletion is proved afterward.

skills.label: Risk Register Builder
skills.desc: Builds a register of risks with owner, likelihood, impact and current controls, and keeps every rating next to its evidence.

skills.label: Risk Scorer
skills.desc: Rates likelihood and impact on a stated scale and shows how the score changes if a control fails.

skills.label: Risk Treatment Planner
skills.desc: Chooses to avoid, reduce, transfer or accept each risk, records who accepted what and sets a review date.

skills.label: Third-Party Risk Assessor
skills.desc: Rates a supplier or model provider on data handling, security posture and concentration risk and lists the questions it still must answer.

skills.label: Agent Boundary Definer
skills.desc: Lists what an agent may observe, decide, change and call, and what stays with the host system.

skills.label: Oversight and Escalation Planner
skills.desc: Defines what is monitored, which signals page a person and how an agent is stopped or rolled back.

skills.label: AI Red Team Planner
skills.desc: Plans adversarial tests, such as jailbreak attempts, of an agent against its stated limits, with scenarios, pass criteria and how findings are reported.

skills.label: Safety Case Writer
skills.desc: Writes the assurance argument, in GSN style, that an agent is safe for a stated use, with the claims, evidence and known limits laid out.

skills.label: Benchmark Runner
skills.desc: Runs a coding agent on a fixed task suite in clean environments and reports pass rate with its variance.

skills.label: Trajectory Analyst
skills.desc: Reads an agent's step-by-step transcript to find where it went wrong, such as looping, ignoring errors or editing the wrong file.

skills.label: Agent Loop Designer
skills.desc: Designs the tool-calling loop with stop conditions, retry limits and a budget for steps and tokens.

skills.label: Context Assembler
skills.desc: Chooses which files, results and messages enter the model's context and compacts the rest without losing decisions.

skills.label: Tool Schema Designer
skills.desc: Defines tool names, input schemas and error messages so a model can call each tool correctly and recover from failure.

skills.label: Handoff Reporter
skills.desc: Writes a short report of what changed, what was verified and what remains, for the next agent or the human.

skills.label: Task Decomposer
skills.desc: Splits a large coding task into independent subtasks with clear inputs and outputs and an order of dependence.

skills.label: Worktree Coordinator
skills.desc: Assigns subtasks to separate branches or worktrees, detects conflicts and merges results in a safe order.

skills.label: Permission Policy Writer
skills.desc: Writes allow and deny rules for commands and paths and the approval prompts for actions that change things outside the sandbox.

skills.label: Sandbox Designer
skills.desc: Designs the container or process boundary an agent runs in, including file, network and process limits.

skills.label: Secrets Guard
skills.desc: Keeps credentials out of prompts, logs and commits by scanning for them and routing access through scoped tokens.

skills.label: Agent Infrastructure Engineering
skills.desc: Designs and provisions the infrastructure layer for agent deployments: compute, networking, secret management, and health monitoring.

skills.label: Agent Platform Engineering
skills.desc: Builds the platform abstractions agents run on: scheduling, load balancing, autoscaling, and the observability integrations the platform provides.

skills.label: Agent Runtime Engineering
skills.desc: Executes agent code inside enforced resource and isolation contracts, priced by risk budget, with purge-on-completion state discipline.

skills.label: Distributed Agent Runtime Engineering
skills.desc: Operates agent runtimes across distributed compute: work distribution, fault tolerance, state coherence, and split-brain prevention.

skills.label: Multi-Tenant Agent Infrastructure
skills.desc: Provisions and isolates agent infrastructure across tenants: resource quotas, network separation, and tenant-scoped secret stores.

skills.label: Agent-to-Agent Protocol Engineering
skills.desc: Defines, validates, versions, and adapts schema-checked A2A envelopes so any conformant agent can exchange work with the network.

skills.label: AI Platform Engineering
skills.desc: Engineers the end-to-end AI platform: model serving, tool integration, agent orchestration endpoints, and platform-level observability.

skills.label: Context Infrastructure Engineering
skills.desc: Engineers the infrastructure that serves context to agents: retrieval endpoints, caching layers, and contract-validated context APIs.

skills.label: Inference Pipeline Engineering
skills.desc: Engineers the pipeline from request to model inference: batching, routing, caching, and contract-validated responses.

skills.label: Model Context Protocol Engineering
skills.desc: Builds and operates MCP servers: tool registration, capability advertisement, auth, and the lazy-load manifest pattern.

skills.label: Multi-MCP Federation
skills.desc: Federates multiple MCP servers behind a unified discovery surface; routes tool calls to the right server without exposing federation internals to call

skills.label: Protocol Translation
skills.desc: Translates between A2A, MCP, and foreign agent frameworks' message shapes without loss of contract fields.

skills.label: Tool Capability Discovery
skills.desc: Discovers what tools and capabilities are available in the current environment: MCP servers, APIs, and local capabilities.

skills.label: Tool Schema Negotiation
skills.desc: Publishes owned, versioned service contracts; discovers and negotiates capabilities before first call; tests contracts in both directions.

skills.label: Agent Card Writer
skills.desc: Writes an agent card that states skills, endpoint, input and output types and authentication so other agents can find and call it.

skills.label: Handoff Contract Writer
skills.desc: Specifies what context, files and authority pass from one agent to another and what stays behind.

skills.label: Task Lifecycle Designer
skills.desc: Defines task states, updates and cancellation between agents and what each side must do on failure or timeout.

skills.label: Error and Pagination Designer
skills.desc: Designs error bodies, pagination, rate-limit signals and idempotency keys so clients can retry safely.

skills.label: OpenAPI Document Writer
skills.desc: Writes an OpenAPI description from an API, with examples and error shapes, and validates it with a linter.

skills.label: API Resource Modeler
skills.desc: Models resources and relations as endpoints, with names, verbs and status codes chosen to match common practice.

skills.label: Contract Test Writer
skills.desc: Writes tests that check an implementation against the written contract, with one test per rule.

skills.label: Protocol Message Fuzzer
skills.desc: Sends malformed and boundary-case messages to an endpoint and reports crashes, hangs and unsafe behaviour.

skills.label: Mock Server Builder
skills.desc: Builds a mock server from a schema that returns valid and error responses so clients can be tested offline.

skills.label: MCP Client Configurator
skills.desc: Configures a client to connect to chosen servers, lists the tools it will expose and the permission each one needs.

skills.label: MCP Server Builder

skills.label: Tool Description Writer
skills.desc: Writes tool names and descriptions so a model picks the right tool, and tests them with sample requests; adds annotations such as read-only hints.

skills.label: Boundary Validator

skills.label: Contract Differ

skills.label: JSON Schema Author

skills.label: Streaming Response Designer

skills.label: Timeout and Retry Planner
skills.desc: Sets timeouts, retry rules with backoff and limits and shows which calls are safe to repeat.

skills.label: Transport Selector

skills.label: Deprecation Notice Writer

skills.label: Migration Guide Writer
skills.desc: Writes step by step migration instructions and a changelog between two versions with before and after examples.

skills.label: Version Number Advisor

skills.label: Failed Build Diagnoser

skills.label: Pipeline Designer

skills.label: Compute Sizer

skills.label: Runtime Selector

skills.label: Container Image Planner

skills.label: Kubernetes Manifest Reviewer

skills.label: Module Designer

skills.label: Terraform Plan Reviewer

skills.label: Network Path Tracer

skills.label: TLS and DNS Checker

skills.label: Minimal Diff Editor

skills.label: Refactor Planner

skills.label: Code Search

skills.label: Dependency Auditor

skills.label: Pull Request Reviewer

skills.label: Vulnerability Scanner

skills.label: Code Vulnerability Reviewer

skills.label: Dependency Risk Checker

skills.label: ML Paper Review

skills.label: Code Review

skills.label: Refactoring Plan

skills.label: Test Suite Builder

skills.label: Distributed System Design

skills.desc: Derives time and space complexity of algorithms and checks bounds with empirical runtime scaling.

skills.label: Graph Algorithm Runner

skills.label: Automaton Constructor
skills.desc: Constructs a finite automaton or Turing machine for a language and tests it on accepted and rejected strings.

skills.label: Complexity Classifier
skills.desc: Classifies a decision problem by complexity class with a reduction, checked by reviewing the reduction steps.

skills.label: Natural Deduction Proof Checker
skills.desc: Builds or checks a natural deduction proof in propositional or first-order logic, verified rule by rule.

skills.label: DNS Record Explainer
skills.desc: Explains the DNS records a domain needs for a deployment and what each one does.

skills.label: Endpoint Mapper

skills.label: Promotion Planner

skills.label: Website Hosting Planner

skills.label: Accessibility Auditor

skills.label: Component Designer

skills.label: Framework Selector

skills.label: CSS Debugger
skills.desc: Finds why an element is positioned or styled wrongly and gives the minimal CSS fix.

skills.label: Responsive Layout Builder

skills.label: Console Error Triage

skills.label: End-to-End Test Writer
skills.desc: Writes end-to-end browser tests for a user flow with assertions on what the user sees.

skills.label: Web Performance Auditor

skills.label: Website Builder
skills.desc: Plans and builds a website: pages, navigation, content, build tooling and deploy target.

skills.label: Scope Minimizer

skills.label: Access Policy Designer

skills.label: OAuth Flow Explainer
skills.desc: Explains which OAuth flow fits an application and the steps of that flow.

skills.label: Key Rotation Planner

skills.label: Secret Leak Responder
skills.desc: Lists the steps after a secret is leaked: revoke, rotate, audit use and prevent recurrence.

skills.label: Threat Model Builder
skills.desc: Builds a threat model for a system: assets, attackers, attack paths and mitigations ranked by risk.

skills.label: Contradiction Finder

skills.label: Deprecation Planner
skills.desc: Plans how a fact or page is retired: redirect, replacement, notice and what depends on it.

skills.label: Review Queue Manager
skills.desc: Orders items for human review by risk and use, tracks decisions and reports review backlog.

skills.label: Claim Extractor

skills.label: Entity and Relation Extractor

skills.label: Table to Graph Mapper

skills.label: Freshness Tracker
skills.desc: Records when each fact was last confirmed, sets a review interval by how fast it changes and lists items past due.

skills.label: Provenance Annotator

skills.label: Naming Convention Writer

skills.label: Graph Query Writer

skills.label: Inference Rule Writer

skills.label: Duplicate Record Finder

skills.label: Identifier Linker

skills.label: Cohort Phenotyping
skills.desc: Defines a patient cohort from EHR codes and rules, checked by chart review sample.

skills.label: Terminology Mapping
skills.desc: Maps local codes to standard terminologies, checked by validated crosswalk coverage.

skills.label: Clinical Trial Search
skills.desc: Finds relevant clinical trials by condition and eligibility, checked against registry identifiers.

skills.label: Differential Expression Analysis

skills.label: Variant Calling Pipeline
skills.desc: Runs alignment and variant calling on sequencing reads, checked against a truth set for precision and recall.

skills.label: Variant Interpretation

skills.label: Image Registration

skills.label: Medical Image Segmentation

skills.label: Radiomics Feature Extraction
skills.desc: Extracts quantitative image features for outcome models, checked by test-retest reproducibility.

skills.label: Cardiac Electrophysiology Simulation

skills.label: Multiscale Model Review
skills.desc: Reviews a multiscale physiology model for assumptions and validation, checked by a credibility checklist.

skills.label: Pharmacokinetic Model

skills.label: Cell Cycle and Signalling Analyst
skills.desc: Maps signalling pathways and cell-cycle checkpoints and explains the effect of perturbing a node.

skills.label: Cell Culture Protocol Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews standard cell culture protocols for missing controls, contamination risk and record keeping, and defers pathogen work to biosafety review.

skills.label: Membrane and Organelle Explainer
skills.desc: Explains membrane transport, organelle function and trafficking at a level the learner chooses.

skills.label: Central Dogma Explainer

skills.label: Gene Regulation Analyst
skills.desc: Explains promoters, enhancers and transcription factors and reads expression data for regulatory patterns.

skills.label: PCR and Cloning Planner

skills.label: Neural Circuit Analyst
skills.desc: Describes circuits from connectivity and activity data and states what the data cannot show about causation.

skills.label: Neuroimaging Analyst
skills.desc: Plans and reads EEG and fMRI analyses with preprocessing, statistics and multiple-comparison control.

skills.label: Neuron Electrophysiology Modeler
skills.desc: Simulates membrane potentials with Hodgkin-Huxley style models and fits parameters to recordings.

skills.label: Synaptic Plasticity Explainer
skills.desc: Explains long-term potentiation and depression, learning rules and their link to memory models.

skills.label: Immune Response Analyst
skills.desc: Explains innate and adaptive immune responses and reads immunology data such as cytokine panels for research use.

skills.label: Organ System Physiology Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how organ systems regulate homeostasis for learning and research, not for diagnosis or treatment.

skills.label: Cell Cycle Analyst
skills.desc: Explains cell cycle phases and checkpoints and what goes wrong in disease, checked against cited literature.

skills.label: Gene Expression Walkthrough
skills.desc: Walks through transcription, processing and translation for a given gene, checked against the gene's documented structure.

skills.label: Signaling Pathway Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a signaling or metabolic pathway step by step, checked by naming the enzyme or receptor and source for each step.

skills.label: Cognitive Task Designer

skills.label: Memory Model Fitter
skills.desc: Fits signal detection and forgetting models to recall data and checks parameter recovery.

skills.label: Reaction Time Analyzer
skills.desc: Cleans and models reaction time data with mixed models and checks outlier rules and model fit.

skills.label: Reasoning Bias Reviewer
skills.desc: Explains a reasoning or decision bias and the evidence for it, checked against replication results.

skills.label: Behavioral Data Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes behavioral data with mixed-effects models, checked by rerunning the analysis.

skills.label: Cognitive Experiment Designer
skills.desc: Designs a reaction-time or memory experiment with conditions and power analysis, checked by an independent power computation.

skills.label: Bayesian Cognitive Modeler
skills.desc: Builds a Bayesian model of a cognitive task and fits it to data, checked by comparing fit against a baseline.

skills.label: Connectionist Model Simulator
skills.desc: Simulates a connectionist model of learning and compares its error pattern to human data.

skills.label: Cognitive Model Literature Reviewer
skills.desc: Summarizes competing computational models of a phenomenon, checked for citation accuracy.

skills.label: Pragmatic Inference Analyzer
skills.desc: Explains implicatures and presuppositions of an utterance, checked against Gricean and formal accounts.

skills.label: Compositional Semantics Builder
skills.desc: Derives a logical form for a sentence with lambda calculus, checked by evaluating it in a model.

skills.label: Syntactic Parse Builder
skills.desc: Produces a constituency or dependency parse of a sentence, checked against a treebank convention.

skills.label: Human Genetic Variation Review
skills.desc: Summarises population genetic variation studies and checks interpretations for race and ancestry misuse.

skills.label: Hominin Fossil Comparison
skills.desc: Compares hominin fossil traits and dates and checks placements against the published phylogenetic literature.

skills.label: Skeletal Biological Profile
skills.desc: Estimates age, sex and stature from skeletal measurements and checks the estimates against reference standards.

skills.label: Ecosystem and Biodiversity Analyst
skills.desc: Computes diversity indices and species distributions and states the sampling limits of the data.

skills.label: Phylogenetics Builder
skills.desc: Builds phylogenetic trees from sequences with alignment, model choice and support values.

skills.label: Population Dynamics Modeler
skills.desc: Models growth, competition and predator-prey dynamics and tests them against field data.

skills.label: Genome Assembly and Annotation
skills.desc: Plans assembly and gene annotation pipelines and reports assembly quality statistics.

skills.label: Population Genetics Analyst

skills.label: Variant Interpretation Assistant

skills.label: Adaptation Case Study

skills.label: Hominin Timeline

skills.label: Biomedical Literature Search
skills.desc: Finds peer-reviewed articles and preprints on a human biology question, checked by verifying identifiers and publication status.

skills.label: Hardy-Weinberg Tester

skills.label: Pedigree Analysis
skills.desc: Infers inheritance mode and genotype probabilities from a pedigree, checked by recomputing each probability.

skills.label: Variant Frequency Lookup
skills.desc: Looks up variant and allele frequency in genomics datasets, checked by reporting dataset, cohort size and query.

skills.label: Anatomical Terminology
skills.desc: Translates descriptions into correct anatomical planes, directions and landmark terms, checked against the standard terminology.

skills.label: Histology Identifier
skills.desc: Identifies tissue types from described microscopic features, checked by listing the diagnostic features for each tissue.

skills.label: Organ System Mapper
skills.desc: Maps an organ to its system, location, blood supply and innervation, checked against standard anatomical references.

skills.label: Biology of Aging Review
skills.desc: Summarises cellular and systemic mechanisms of aging, checked by citing a primary study for each mechanism.

skills.label: Embryonic Development Timeline
skills.desc: Lays out embryonic stages and when organ systems form, checked against standard embryology staging.

skills.label: Growth Curve Assessment
skills.desc: Places a measurement on a growth reference and reports the percentile, checked by recomputing the percentile.

skills.label: Homeostasis Loop Analyst
skills.desc: Describes the sensor, control centre and effector of a feedback loop, checked by tracing the response to a perturbation.

skills.label: Endocrine Pathway Tracer
skills.desc: Traces a hormone from secretion to target and feedback, checked against the literature for each step.

skills.label: Physiological Calculator
skills.desc: Computes quantities such as cardiac output, clearance and ventilation from inputs, checked by units and plausible reference ranges.

skills.label: Neuroimaging Result Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews fMRI and EEG findings and checks multiple-comparison correction and reported coordinates.

skills.label: Neurotransmitter Function Mapper
skills.desc: Maps neurotransmitter systems to behaviours and drug effects and checks claims against biomedical literature.

skills.label: Diagnostic Criteria Mapper
skills.desc: Maps a symptom description to DSM criteria for study purposes and checks each criterion is met or not met explicitly.

skills.label: Psychometric Validator
skills.desc: Validates clinical scales with factor analysis and checks reliability and validity coefficients.

skills.label: Treatment Evidence Reviewer

skills.label: Attachment Classification Coder
skills.desc: Codes attachment behaviour from observation protocols and checks inter-rater reliability.

skills.label: Developmental Milestone Checker
skills.desc: Compares a child profile to normative milestones and checks each against published norms.

skills.label: Longitudinal Design Planner

skills.label: Meta-Analysis Runner

skills.label: Power Analysis Calculator
skills.desc: Computes required sample sizes for planned tests and checks assumptions about effect size.

skills.label: Psychology Literature Search
skills.desc: Searches journals and preprints on a question and checks each cited finding against its source.

skills.label: Attitude Survey Builder

skills.label: Personality Profile Scorer

skills.label: Replication Assessor
skills.desc: Evaluates the replicability of a social psychology finding and checks effect sizes and preregistration status.

skills.label: Behavior Theory Selection

skills.label: Partnership Planning

skills.label: Disease Rate Calculation

skills.label: Observational Study Review

skills.label: Policy Evidence Brief

skills.label: Logic Model Builder
skills.desc: Builds a logic model linking inputs, activities, outputs and outcomes and checks every outcome has a measurable indicator.

skills.label: Implementation Fidelity Check

skills.label: Sample Size Calculation

skills.label: Trial Protocol Drafting

skills.label: Risk and Protective Factor Mapping

skills.label: Screening Program Evaluation

skills.label: Atmospheric Stability Analysis

skills.label: Climate Feedback Analysis

skills.label: Emissions Scenario Comparison

skills.label: Temperature Trend Detection
skills.desc: Fits trends to temperature records with uncertainty, checked by significance tests and dataset agreement.

skills.label: Aerosol Effects Review
skills.desc: Summarizes direct and indirect aerosol effects and their uncertainty, checked against cited literature.

skills.label: Radiative Forcing Estimator

skills.label: Carbon Budget Analyst

skills.label: Ecosystem Response Analyst

skills.label: Climate Trend Analyzer
skills.desc: Computes temperature and precipitation trends from station or reanalysis records and checks significance and homogeneity.

skills.label: Climate Forcing Attributor

skills.label: Natural Hazard Mapper

skills.label: Land Cover Classifier

skills.desc: Maps plot, story time and point of view in a film and checks the map against scene order.

skills.label: Scene Interpretation
skills.desc: Interprets how formal choices in a scene create meaning and checks every claim is tied to a specific visible or audible detail.

skills.label: Shot-by-Shot Analysis
skills.desc: Breaks a sequence into shots with scale, angle, movement and duration and checks the shot list against the timecodes.

skills.label: Auteur Study
skills.desc: Identifies recurring style and themes across a director's films and checks each claim against named works.

skills.label: Genre Evolution Study
skills.desc: Traces a genre's conventions over time across representative films and checks each example's date and credits.

skills.label: Film Movement Profile
skills.desc: Profiles a movement such as Italian neorealism or the French New Wave with its context, style and key works and checks dates and attributions.

skills.label: Box Office and Distribution Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses release strategy and grosses for a film and checks figures against a named reporting source.

skills.label: Edit and Post-Production Planning
skills.desc: Plans an edit with assembly, rough cut and sound passes and checks continuity across the cut list.

skills.label: Screenplay Breakdown
skills.desc: Breaks a screenplay into scenes, locations, cast and props for scheduling and checks the breakdown against the script pages.

skills.label: Screen Studies Scholarship Search
skills.desc: Searches peer-reviewed film and media scholarship through Wiley Scholar Gateway and checks each citation resolves to the stated work.

skills.label: Semiotic Reading
skills.desc: Identifies signs, codes and connotations in an image or advertisement and checks each reading against visible evidence.

skills.label: Theory Application
skills.desc: Applies a theoretical framework such as the male gaze or Bazinian realism to a film and checks the application against the theorist's text.

skills.label: Audience Reception Study
skills.desc: Analyses how audiences interpret a programme from reviews and fan discourse and checks the sample is described.

skills.label: Streaming Platform Strategy
skills.desc: Explains how a streaming platform commissions, releases and recommends content and checks claims against company reporting.

skills.label: Serial Narrative Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses season and episode arcs in a series and checks arcs against an episode guide.

skills.label: Historical Chronology Building
skills.desc: Builds a dated sequence of events for a period or country and checks each date against at least two reference sources.

skills.label: Historiographical Debate Review
skills.desc: Summarises competing interpretations of an event such as the origins of the First World War and checks each position against its key authors.

skills.label: Primary Source Criticism
skills.desc: Evaluates a historical document for authorship, date, audience and bias and checks its claims against corroborating sources.

skills.label: Ancient Empire Comparison
skills.desc: Compares administration, economy and decline across ancient empires, checked by sourcing each comparative claim.

skills.label: Feudal Structure Analyst
skills.desc: Explains landholding, lordship and obligation in medieval societies, checked by distinguishing regional variants with sources.

skills.label: Manuscript and Inscription Reader
skills.desc: Interprets the content and context of ancient inscriptions and medieval manuscripts, checked against published editions and translations.

skills.label: Calendar Converter
skills.desc: Converts dates between Julian, Gregorian, regnal and other calendars, checked by recomputing each conversion with a second method.

skills.label: Causation and Continuity Analysis
skills.desc: Distinguishes long-term causes, triggers and continuities behind an event, checked by tying each causal claim to dated evidence.

skills.label: Timeline Builder
skills.desc: Builds a dated sequence of events with sources for each date, checked for internal consistency and calendar conversion errors.

skills.label: Comparative History Framework
skills.desc: Compares a phenomenon across two or more societies with explicit criteria, checked by applying each criterion to every case.

skills.label: Social History Data Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses census, parish and tax records to describe class, labor and household patterns, checked by recomputing totals from the records.

skills.label: Trade Network Reconstruction
skills.desc: Reconstructs historical trade routes and exchanges of goods and people, checked by sourcing each route and commodity.

skills.label: Archive Search Planner
skills.desc: Plans where and how to find primary sources in archives and catalogs, checked by confirming every listed collection and finding aid exists.

skills.label: Historical Citation Builder
skills.desc: Formats footnotes and bibliographies for archival and published sources, checked against the citation style's rules for each source type.

skills.label: Source Criticism
skills.desc: Assesses a document's authorship, date, purpose and bias, and is checked by corroborating each claim against at least one independent source.

skills.label: Historiographical Debate Summary
skills.desc: Summarises a scholarly debate with each position, its evidence and its main proponents, checked by confirming every attributed claim in the cited work.

skills.label: Revisionism Tracker
skills.desc: Traces how the interpretation of an event changed across generations of historians, checked by dating each interpretation to its publication.

skills.label: Interpretive School Mapper
skills.desc: Places a historical work within schools such as Annales, Marxist or cultural history, checked by citing the passages that show the method.

skills.label: Oral History Protocol
skills.desc: Designs and documents oral history interviews with consent and transcription standards, checked against oral history ethics guidelines.

skills.label: Revolution Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses the causes, phases and outcomes of political revolutions, checked by dating each phase and citing sources.

skills.label: War and Conflict History
skills.desc: Reconstructs the origins, conduct and consequences of wars, checked against documented casualties, treaties and dates.

skills.label: Melody Harmonizer
skills.desc: Harmonises a melody in a chosen style and checks the result for voice leading errors.

skills.label: Notation Engraver
skills.desc: Produces engraved score notation from sketches and checks beaming, spelling and part extraction.

skills.label: Orchestration Range Checker
skills.desc: Arranges parts for an ensemble and checks every note lies in the playable range of its instrument.

skills.label: Cultural Context Analyst
skills.desc: Interprets the social meaning of a musical practice and checks the reading against ethnographic literature.

skills.label: Field Recording Annotator
skills.desc: Annotates field recordings with performer, context and genre metadata and checks entries with community and archive sources.

skills.label: Lyric Translator
skills.desc: Translates song lyrics for study and checks meaning and singability with a native speaker review.

skills.label: Repertoire Program Builder
skills.desc: Builds concert programs that fit a theme and duration and checks timings and instrumentation.

skills.label: Source Criticism Reviewer
skills.desc: Compares manuscript and edition variants of a score and checks claims of authorship and date against archive records.

skills.label: Style Period Identifier
skills.desc: Places a work in a style period from its musical features and checks the attribution against documented sources.

skills.label: Audio Feature Extractor
skills.desc: Extracts tempo, key and spectral features from audio and checks estimates against annotated ground truth.

skills.label: Listening Experiment Designer
skills.desc: Designs perception experiments on rhythm or emotion and checks stimuli and statistics for confounds.

skills.label: Mix Balance Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews loudness, equalisation and stereo balance of a mix and checks metering against delivery standards.

skills.label: Species Counterpoint Checker
skills.desc: Writes and checks species counterpoint for parallel fifths, octaves and dissonance treatment.

skills.label: Musical Form Mapper
skills.desc: Segments a piece into sections such as sonata or rondo form and checks boundaries against thematic and key evidence.

skills.label: Roman Numeral Harmonic Analyzer
skills.desc: Labels chords and cadences with Roman numerals and checks the analysis against voice leading and key context.

skills.label: Recording Interpretation Comparer
skills.desc: Compares tempo and dynamic choices across recordings and checks measurements against the score.

skills.label: Intonation Analyzer
skills.desc: Measures pitch accuracy in recordings in cents and checks it against the chosen temperament.

skills.label: Practice Plan Designer
skills.desc: Designs deliberate practice plans for a piece and checks progress against tempo and accuracy targets.

skills.label: Gettier Case Builder
skills.desc: Constructs counterexamples to analyses of knowledge and checks each case meets the analysis but intuitively fails.

skills.label: Justification Theory Mapper
skills.desc: Classifies a view as foundationalist, coherentist or reliabilist and checks the classification against its primary text.

skills.label: Skeptical Argument Evaluator
skills.desc: Reconstructs sceptical arguments premise by premise and checks responses address a specific premise.

skills.label: Justice Theory Comparer
skills.desc: Compares theories of justice such as Rawls and Nozick on a policy question and checks fidelity to each text.

skills.label: Philosophy Literature Search
skills.desc: Finds journal articles on a debate and checks each citation exists and supports the attributed claim.

skills.label: Primary Text Explicator
skills.desc: Explains a passage from a primary text in context and checks the reading against the original language and scholarship.

skills.label: Argument Formalizer
skills.desc: Translates natural language arguments into propositional or predicate logic and checks validity with a truth table or derivation.

skills.label: Fallacy Detector
skills.desc: Identifies informal fallacies in texts and checks each label against a standard definition and the passage.

skills.label: Natural Deduction Prover
skills.desc: Constructs natural deduction proofs and checks each line cites a valid rule.

skills.label: Free Will Position Mapper
skills.desc: Maps compatibilist, libertarian and hard determinist positions on a question and checks each against cited sources.

skills.label: Ontological Commitment Analyzer
skills.desc: Identifies what entities a theory commits to and checks the claim using quantifier paraphrase.

skills.label: Thought Experiment Analyzer
skills.desc: Sets out the cases and intuitions in a thought experiment and checks the conclusion follows from them.

skills.label: Machine Mind Assessor
skills.desc: Evaluates claims about machine consciousness and understanding and checks each claim against named criteria.

skills.label: Mind-Body Argument Reconstructor
skills.desc: Reconstructs arguments for dualism and physicalism in standard form and checks premise dependence.

skills.label: Reference Theory Tester
skills.desc: Applies descriptivist and causal theories of reference to cases and checks predictions against the case facts.

skills.label: Philosophy of Mind Argument Mapper
skills.desc: Maps the premises of an argument such as the Chinese room, checked for validity and cited replies.

skills.label: Meaning and Reference Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes a puzzle of reference using descriptivist and causal theories, checked against cited sources.

skills.label: Theory of Mind Comparator
skills.desc: Compares functionalism, computationalism and rivals on a test case, checked against primary texts.

skills.label: Consistency Checker
skills.desc: Checks a set of statements for contradiction, shows the smallest conflicting subset and suggests which statement to drop.

skills.label: Natural Language Formalizer
skills.desc: Rewrites an English statement in logic notation and lists the ambiguities that had to be resolved to do it.

skills.label: Proof Sketcher
skills.desc: Writes a proof as numbered steps with the justification for each and marks any step that is only plausible.

skills.label: Validity Checker
skills.desc: Checks whether a conclusion follows from its premises, shows the inference rule used and builds a counterexample when it does not.

skills.label: Religious Argument Mapper
skills.desc: Maps premises and objections of an argument such as the cosmological argument or the problem of evil, checked for validity.

skills.label: Religious Ethics Comparator
skills.desc: Compares the moral reasoning of traditions on an issue, checked against primary sources.

skills.label: Religious Experience Reviewer
skills.desc: Summarizes philosophical and psychological accounts of religious experience, checked for citation accuracy.

skills.label: Religion and Law Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes how a legal system regulates religion, checked against the cited constitutional or statutory text.

skills.label: New Religious Movement Profiler
skills.desc: Profiles a new religious movement with origins, membership and controversies, checked against scholarly sources.

skills.label: Religious Pluralism Survey Analyzer
skills.desc: Summarizes survey data on affiliation and belief by country, checked against the published dataset.

skills.label: Religious Fieldwork Planner
skills.desc: Plans ethnographic fieldwork at a religious site with consent and access steps, checked against research ethics requirements.

skills.label: Ritual Structure Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes a ritual into phases, roles and symbols using ritual theory, checked against ethnographic descriptions.

skills.label: Sacred Space Describer
skills.desc: Describes the layout and use of a sacred site and its pilgrimage routes, checked against site documentation.

skills.label: Definition of Religion Comparator
skills.desc: Compares substantive and functional definitions of religion against a case and reports which features each captures, checked against cited theorists.

skills.label: Insider-Outsider Method Auditor
skills.desc: Reviews a study for confessional bias and insider-outsider positioning, checked against stated disciplinary norms.

skills.label: Secularization Thesis Reviewer
skills.desc: Summarizes evidence for and against secularization theories in a region, checked for citation accuracy.

skills.label: Cross-Tradition Theme Comparator
skills.desc: Compares how several traditions treat a theme such as death or salvation, checked for flattening of differences.

skills.label: Religious History Timeline Builder
skills.desc: Builds a dated timeline of events in a tradition, with every date checked against a cited source.

skills.label: Tradition Profile Builder
skills.desc: Builds a profile of a tradition with founders, schools, texts and practices, checked against reference scholarship.

skills.label: Artist Statement Writing
skills.desc: Drafts an artist statement and checks it for clarity and consistency with the portfolio work.

skills.label: Portfolio and Grant Preparation
skills.desc: Assembles a portfolio and grant application and checks documentation and requirements against the call.

skills.label: Studio Critique
skills.desc: Runs a structured critique of a work and checks that feedback addresses intent, form and context.

skills.label: Figure and Gesture Study
skills.desc: Guides timed gesture and figure studies and checks anatomy and proportion against reference.

skills.label: Observational Drawing Exercise
skills.desc: Sets an observational drawing exercise and checks the result for proportion, value range and perspective accuracy.

skills.label: Perspective Construction
skills.desc: Constructs one, two and three point perspective for a scene and checks vanishing points and horizon consistency.

skills.label: Interactive Piece Prototyping
skills.desc: Prototypes an interactive or generative artwork in code and checks it runs reliably for the intended duration.

skills.label: Performance Score Writing
skills.desc: Writes a score for a time-based performance and checks timing, roles and documentation plans with a rehearsal.

skills.label: Sound and Projection Design
skills.desc: Designs sound and projection for an installation and checks levels, throw distance and sync on site.

skills.label: Color Mixing and Palette Planning
skills.desc: Plans a limited palette and mixing strategy and checks value and hue relationships with a value study.

skills.label: Composition Planning
skills.desc: Develops thumbnail compositions for a painting and checks balance, focal point and value structure.

skills.label: Painting Media Technique
skills.desc: Advises on oil, acrylic or watercolor technique such as glaze and fat over lean and checks material safety and permanence.

skills.label: Darkroom Processing
skills.desc: Guides film developing and printing and checks chemistry, timing and ventilation against safety guidance.

skills.label: Exposure and Lighting Setup
skills.desc: Sets exposure and lighting for a shoot and checks the result with histogram and test frames.

skills.label: Photo Series Sequencing
skills.desc: Edits and sequences a photo or video series and checks narrative flow with a peer critique pass.

skills.label: Mold Making and Casting
skills.desc: Specifies a mold and casting process in plaster, resin or metal and checks steps against safety data.

skills.label: Fabrication Planning
skills.desc: Plans materials, joins and tools for a sculpture and checks the plan for structural soundness and shop safety.

skills.label: Site-Specific Installation Design
skills.desc: Designs an installation for a given site and checks dimensions, load and audience flow against site constraints.

skills.label: Blocking Plan Builder
skills.desc: Produces a blocking plan for a scene on a given stage configuration, checked for sightlines and traffic.

skills.label: Character Analysis Builder
skills.desc: Builds an actor's character analysis with objectives, obstacles and tactics, checked against the script.

skills.label: Rehearsal Schedule Planner
skills.desc: Builds a rehearsal schedule from scene breakdowns and actor availability, checked for conflicts.

skills.label: Costume Research Builder
skills.desc: Assembles period costume research and renderings notes for characters, checked against historical sources.

skills.label: Lighting Plot Planner
skills.desc: Drafts a lighting plot and cue list for a scene, checked for coverage and cue sequencing.

skills.label: Stage Management Prompt Book Builder
skills.desc: Builds a prompt book with blocking notation and calling cues, checked against the latest script and cue sheets.

skills.label: Adaptation Comparator
skills.desc: Compares a stage adaptation with its source text and records changes, checked against both texts.

skills.label: Dramaturgy Packet Builder
skills.desc: Compiles a production dramaturgy packet with context, glossary and production history, checked for source accuracy.

skills.label: Script Structure Analyzer
skills.desc: Breaks a play into beats, units and given circumstances, checked against the script text.

skills.label: Performance Event Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes a performance or ritual event with performance studies concepts, checked against the cited theory.

skills.label: Performativity Concept Reviewer
skills.desc: Explains performativity and applies it to a case of identity performance, checked against primary texts.

skills.label: Spectatorship Study Designer
skills.desc: Designs an audience response study for a production, checked for method and consent requirements.

skills.label: Devising Workshop Planner
skills.desc: Plans devising exercises and a generative structure for an ensemble, checked against stated goals.

skills.label: Dialogue Feedback Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews dialogue for voice, clarity and stakes, checked by a dramaturgical second read.

skills.label: Scene Drafter
skills.desc: Drafts a dramatic scene with conflict and subtext from a premise, checked for structure in a workshop reading.

skills.label: Global Performance Form Profiler
skills.desc: Profiles a performance form such as Noh or kathakali with conventions and history, checked against scholarship.

skills.label: Period Staging Reconstructor
skills.desc: Reconstructs original staging conditions of a historical play, checked against archaeological and documentary evidence.

skills.label: Theater History Timeline Builder
skills.desc: Builds a dated timeline of a theatrical tradition, with every date checked against a cited source.
